findings.summary: The previous final review's blocker (DD owner-side action-key dedup absent on the production path) is fully resolved: DdControlPlane.gate now accepts action_key and persists an O_EXCL (action_key, generation) claim before launching, DdOwnerSource.resume passes the key through, and TestDdOwnerSideDedup directly drives the real gate against a recording launcher verifying one launch not two. The acceptance process drill still uses a fake HTTP owner per spec item 6's design (fake bus, fake resume owner, real SQLite, real bridge process), but the production DD dedup path is now covered by unit tests rather than only by the process drill.
